d: Delhi witnessed two parallel political protests on November 1, with the INDIA bloc holding a rally at Ramlila Maidan against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral irregularities and vote theft. Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge and Mamata Banerjee called for action against the CEC and demanded an end to the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Meanwhile, the BJP held a march from Hari Nagar to Tilak Nagar, demanding a Congress apology for the 1984 anti-Sikh riots.
